description: This file defines the AppTheme class which provides a customized ThemeData for a Flutter application, specifically tailored for a light mode Ocean Professional color palette. It specifies theme configurations for various UI components including app bar, buttons, input fields, chips, navigation bar, dialogs, and snackbar, utilizing constants from imported color and spacing constants.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to generate a customized light ThemeData for the application.

methods.name: light
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured with the Ocean Professional palette and various UI component styles.

methods.name: _textTheme
methods.description: Defines the TextTheme used within the overall ThemeData, setting text styles for different text types.
